question: In which jurisdiction is the manager of the umbrella fund of the sub-fund 'NT Global Green Bond Index Fund' incorporated?

attempts.sparql:
PREFIX gleif-L1: <https://www.gleif.org/ontology/L1/>
PREFIX gleif-base: <https://www.gleif.org/ontology/Base/>
PREFIX kgx: <https://example.org/gleif-kg/ontology/>
PREFIX lei: <https://www.gleif.org/data/lei/>

SELECT DISTINCT ?jurisdiction WHERE {
  # Find the sub-fund by legal name
  ?subfund gleif-L1:hasLegalName "NT Global Green Bond Index Fund" .
  
  # Get its umbrella fund
  ?subfund kgx:hasUmbrellaFund ?umbrella .
  
  # Get the manager of that umbrella fund
  ?umbrella kgx:hasFundManager ?manager .
  
  # Get the jurisdiction of the manager
  ?manager gleif-base:hasLegalJurisdiction ?jurisdiction .
}

question: Among ISSUED entities incorporated in Luxembourg, which three legal forms are most common, excluding the placeholder codes 8888 and 9999? Give the legal form name and the count.

attempts.sparql:
PREFIX gleif-L1: <https://www.gleif.org/ontology/L1/>
PREFIX gleif-base: <https://www.gleif.org/ontology/Base/>
PREFIX elf: <https://www.gleif.org/data/elf/>
PREFIX jur: <https://www.gleif.org/data/jurisdiction/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

SELECT ?legalFormName (COUNT(?e) AS ?count)
WHERE {
  ?e a gleif-base:Entity ;
     gleif-L1:hasLegalForm ?lf ;
     gleif-base:hasRegistrationStatus gleif-L1:ISSUED ;
     gleif-base:hasLegalJurisdiction jur:LU .
  FILTER (?lf != elf:8888 && ?lf != elf:9999)
  ?lf rdfs:label ?legalFormName .
}
GROUP BY ?legalFormName
ORDER BY DESC(?count)
LIMIT 3

PREFIX gleif-base: <https://www.gleif.org/ontology/Base/>

PREFIX jur: <https://www.gleif.org/data/jurisdiction/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

SELECT ?legalFormName (COUNT(?e) AS ?count)
WHERE {
  ?e a gleif-base:Entity ;
     gleif-L1:hasLegalForm ?lf ;
     gleif-base:hasRegistrationStatus gleif-L1:ISSUED ;
     gleif-base:hasLegalJurisdiction jur:LU .
